newsitem.title: USA: Entertainment Tech gets bank credit line.
newsitem.headline: Entertainment Tech gets bank credit line.

text.p: Entertainment Technologies & Programs Inc said Monday that it had received a bank line of credit and funding totaling $750,000.

Of the total, $450,000 is a revolving credit line with Bayshore National Bank of Houston. The remaining $300,000 was provided by Capital Growth Planning of El Cajon, California, as part of an overall $600,000 financing to be raised in six tranches, the company said.
It said the funds will save it up to about 60 percent on short term borrowings.
Entertainment Technologies said it plans to use the funds to support the roll out of its Performance Sound & Light Catalogue, which it launched in June to the civilian marketplace.
Entertainment Technologies is a government-approved supplier of entertainment service on U.S. military bases worldwide.
